interpretations: For each patient, average the HGB/HCT ratios from lab records with both values present; compare that ratio with the equal-weight mean of all patients’ ratios. For patients above that mean, report the mean of their per-patient average PIC, the mean of their ratios, and the mean excess

For each patient, divide their average nonmissing HGB by their average nonmissing HCT; compare the result with the equal-weight mean of all patients’ resulting ratios. Report the same three means for patients above it

For each patient, divide average HGB by average HCT using only lab records where both are present; compare the result with the equal-weight mean of all patients’ resulting ratios. Report the same three means for patients above it

Average each patient’s valid record-level HGB/HCT ratios, but compare that ratio with the mean across all valid lab-record ratios, so patients with more records carry more weight in the threshold. Report the same three means for qualifying patients
Use each patient’s most recent valid lab-record HGB/HCT ratio as their ratio; compare it with the mean of those ratios across patients. Report the same three means for qualifying patients
Use each patient’s earliest valid lab-record HGB/HCT ratio as their ratio; compare it with the mean of those ratios across patients. Report the same three means for qualifying patients
For qualifying patients, calculate average PIC from all their lab records with PIC present
For qualifying patients, calculate average PIC only from lab records that also have a valid HGB/HCT ratio
queries:
WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM per_patient
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_pic,
    AVG(p.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM per_patient AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(HCT) AS avg_hct
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        avg_hgb,
        avg_hct,
        avg_hgb / NULLIF(avg_hct, 0) AS ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_hgb,
    AVG(avg_hct) AS mean_hct,
    AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
FROM patient_ratios
WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM patient_ratios)

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(HCT) AS avg_hct
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        avg_hgb,
        avg_hct,
        avg_hgb / NULLIF(avg_hct, 0) AS hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT ID, avg_hgb, avg_hct, hgb_hct_ratio
FROM patient_ratios
WHERE hgb_hct_ratio > (
    SELECT AVG(hgb_hct_ratio)
    FROM patient_ratios
)

WITH valid_records AS (
    SELECT ID, HGB, HCT, HGB / HCT AS hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT > 0
),
patient_means AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB) AS mean_hgb,
           AVG(HCT) AS mean_hct,
           AVG(hgb_hct_ratio) AS mean_hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM valid_records
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT ID, mean_hgb, mean_hct, mean_hgb_hct_ratio
FROM patient_means
WHERE mean_hgb_hct_ratio > (
    SELECT AVG(hgb_hct_ratio)
    FROM valid_records
)

WITH ranked_labs AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        HGB,
        HCT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND HCT <> 0
),
latest_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, HGB, HCT, HGB / HCT AS ratio
    FROM ranked_labs
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    AVG(HGB) AS mean_hgb,
    AVG(HCT) AS mean_hct,
    AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
FROM latest_ratios
WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM latest_ratios);

WITH ranked_labs AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        HGB,
        HCT,
        HGB / HCT AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB > 0 AND HCT > 0
),
earliest AS (
    SELECT HGB, HCT, ratio
    FROM ranked_labs
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    AVG(HGB) AS mean_hgb,
    AVG(HCT) AS mean_hct,
    AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
FROM earliest
WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM earliest)
